anomalies.observed: U2 pin 1 (RO) is connected to net NET00301 and U2 pin 4 (DI) is connected to net NET00040. These net labels do not appear anywhere else on the schematic. The M5Stack bus UART nets, which should connect to these pins, are NET0030 (J6/J2 pin 16) and NET0007 (J6/J2 pin 15) respectively.
anomalies.expected: U2 pin 1 (RO) should connect to the M5Stack RXD2 net (spec says J1/J2 pin 16), and U2 pin 4 (DI) should connect to the M5Stack TXD2 net (spec says J1/J2 pin 15).

evidence.quote: U2 pin 1 labeled NET00301; U2 pin 4 labeled NET00040; J6 pin 16 labeled NET0030; J6 pin 15 labeled NET0007

anomalies.impact: The MAX3485 transceiver is completely isolated from the M5Stack UART. Serial servo mode will not function at all: the board cannot transmit to or receive from serial servos.

anomalies.observed: The battery switch Q2 drain net NET0027 is connected to J6/J2 pin 25. The specification states the battery should be wired to pin 29 of the M5Stack bus connectors.
anomalies.expected: The battery net (NET0027) should be connected to J6/J2 pin 29, the M5Stack BAT bus pin.

evidence.quote: wired straight to pin 29 of the M5Stack bus connectors (J1/J2)
J6 pin 25 labeled NET0027 (battery net); J6 pin 29 labeled NET0029

anomalies.impact: The battery is connected to a GPIO pin instead of the BAT pin. The M5Stack Core cannot charge the battery or use it as its battery supply, and battery voltage may be applied to a GPIO, potentially damaging the Core.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains at least two anomalies: the MAX3485 UART connections use net labels (NET00301, NET00040) that do not match the M5Stack UART nets (NET0030, NET0007), leaving the serial interface open; and the battery net is routed to bus pin 25 instead of the specified pin 29, preventing proper battery operation.
